headline: Citigroup Receives Beijing Approval for Wholly Owned China Securities Unit
summary: Citigroup received approval from the China Securities Regulatory Commission to set up a wholly foreign-owned securities firm in mainland China.
why: Full ownership licenses allow foreign banks to expand capital market operations and capture greater fee income in China.

impacts.name: Citigroup
impacts.why: Gaining a wholly owned securities license expands Citigroup's addressable market and revenue streams in Chinese capital markets.

why_moved: Securing regulatory green light for a wholly owned securities unit opens significant growth opportunities for Citigroup in China.
